material_findings: The prior same-event exact-score B1 candidate did not recur in the next independent exact-main smoke and therefore fails the challenger recurrence criterion.

The new maker-positive B1 candidate is a semantic relation between an Ethereum threshold and a Bitcoin threshold; generic template overlap relaxed the scanner relation gate despite no shared proposition-specific asset anchor.

A research-only B1 intent admission guard now fails closed on semantic rows without a shared proposition-specific slug anchor, while preserving same-event, latent-correlation, and same-asset threshold relations.

why_generic_overlap_is_not_enough.incumbent_effect: The scanner labels the pair semantic and therefore uses the relaxed semantic correlation/reversion path rather than the stronger latent-correlation path.
why_generic_overlap_is_not_enough.challenger_effect: The intent adapter requires a shared nonnumeric, noncalendar, non-template anchor before a semantic row can reach the broker.

current_b2_context.note: B2 relation quality, sparse hedges, persistence and completion economics remain owned by existing LF/HF research and are not duplicated here.
